# Iteration-test before macOS promotion

Exact authored snapshot of `scenarios/iteration-test` immediately before its
November 5, 2026 replacement with the Mac-inclusive version. The original Scenario
2.0 YAML, includes, relative email corpus and environment briefing are preserved
byte for byte; `ORIGIN.json` records their SHA-256 hashes. The earlier Scenario 1.0
ancestor remains in `../iteration-test-1_0/`.

This reference has 8 users and 21 Windows/Linux systems, with a six-hour collection
window starting March 18, 2024 at 12:00 UTC. Its pinned technology industry pack,
original identifier and output destination are intentionally unchanged. To regenerate
it, supply an explicit separate `--output` directory so it cannot write into the
active benchmark. No generated artifacts or assessment scores are part of this copy.

The active benchmark is `scenarios/iteration-test/scenario.yaml`; its environment
adds two macOS workstations. The composition-lineage regression uses this historical
snapshot to retain the original Scenario 1.0 → packed Scenario 2.0 comparison.
